prior_summary: A Cartesian Diffusion Policy whose action frame follows observed block translation only in the open-drawer, TCP-near-block release neighborhood and otherwise equals the observed drawer-attached target_pose frame.
applicable_conditions: Prefer at an early placement-to-closure handoff when the drawer is near fully open, object_pose is reliable, the TCP is close to the block, and block/TCP displacement relative to the demonstrated drawer location is the main concern. It remains defined at later valid close-drawer phases because its interaction gate becomes zero.
termination_guidance: Terminate only under the unchanged physical guidance: drawer_position below 0.025 m and nearly stationary, block inside the drawer near floor height, fingers open, and TCP high and clear. The interaction gate is not a success predicate.
limitations: The analytic gate is not contact detection and can select the wrong frame for a noisy, bouncing, far-away, or handle-adjacent block. It does not cover missed grasp, jam, obstruction, changed handle geometry, collision, or unreachable IK, and its out-of-distribution benefit is unconfirmed.
